functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the solution meets the requirements and behaves as expected in all specified scenarios.

edge_case_handling.description: Assesses how well the solution addresses edge cases and boundary conditions specific to the problem.

efficiency.description: Measures the time complexity of the solution against the expected performance, particularly for large inputs.

robustness.description: Evaluates the solution's ability to handle unexpected inputs or situations without failing.

api_library_usage.description: Assesses the appropriateness and effectiveness of any APIs or libraries used in the solution.

readability_maintainability.description: Evaluates how easy the code is to read and maintain, including naming conventions and code structure.

error_handling_security.description: Assesses how well the solution anticipates and handles errors or security vulnerabilities.
